acceptance: --capture-plans on Exasol records parsed plans for TPC-H queries
Timed results with capture on and off agree within run-to-run noise (evidence recorded)
Parser has fixtures with recorded provenance and passes cross-engine conformance tests
context:
Item-specific guardrails: never profile timed executions. The capture phase re-executes queries in a separate pass. Do not fabricate plan structure the profile does not contain.

Shared Exasol guardrails: worktree-only writes with make agent-write-preflight; explicit-path staging, never git add -A; commit identity check, no attribution trailers; uv only; lazy pyexasol import; no credentials in Git, logs, fixtures, or tracker; no live cloud runs; code-skill self-review then make pr-preflight and make pr-open, no auto-merge without make pr-ready; durable artifacts carry no tracker IDs or session narrative; stop and report on failed gates, unverified behavior, license questions, or unapproved host changes.
description:
Exasol has no EXPLAIN. Plans exist only as profiling data, after execution: `ALTER SESSION SET PROFILE='ON'`, run the query, `FLUSH STATISTICS`, then read `EXA_USER_PROFILE_LAST_DAY` (or `EXA_STATISTICS.EXA_USER_PROFILE_LAST_DAY`) filtered by session and statement ID. Add capture and a parser so that `--capture-plans` works for Exasol.

Tasks:
1. Measure profiling overhead: timed TPC-H SF 1 runs with PROFILE on and off.
2. Implement capture in the isolated post-measurement phase: re-run each query in a separate profiled pass, never inside timed execution. Implement `get_query_plan` / `get_query_plan_parser`.
3. Add `benchbox/core/query_plans/parsers/exasol.py` following existing parsers, with fixtures and provenance recorded in tests/fixtures/query_plans/PROVENANCE.md.
4. Add conformance tests in tests/unit/query_plans alongside the existing engines.

Decision gates:
- G1 Start only with explicit user priority.
- G2 If profiling cannot be isolated from timed execution, stop. Plan capture must not change measured timings.
- G3 If profile rows lack the operator structure the parser framework needs, stop and report instead of synthesizing a plan tree.
